result.summary: Found 1 issue: the promotional banner text is visually broken due to white-on-light-background low contrast making it nearly unreadable.

issues.description: Promotional banner '3 free deliveries for you' and subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' uses white text on a very light mint-green background, making it nearly illegible due to extremely low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color (e.g., dark green/black) on the light banner background to meet WCAG contrast requirements and ensure readability.
